prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: low-speed head-on collision in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1268; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative: On arrival at the reported collision site in Conroe, Texas, I observed two vehicles with front-end damage in the eastbound lane of the roadway. Driver 1 stated that Driver 2's vehicle crossed the centerline while attempting to pass a slow-moving truck, resulting in a low-speed head-on impact. Driver 2 stated that Driver 1 drifted toward the centerline shortly before contact. Both drivers were able to exit their vehicles under their own power. Driver 1 reported pain in the lower back and stated that the pain began shortly after impact. A Passenger in Driver 2's vehicle reported no injury. Airbags did not deploy in either vehicle. Both vehicles were drivable with assistance and were removed from the roadway by tow. No citations were issued at the scene pending review of witness statements. Photographs of both vehicles and the roadway were taken and are attached to this report. Emergency medical services were offered to Driver 1, who declined transport at the time of the report.
